notes.title: The G-Rebels Demo Returns for Gamescom – Play Until August 24!
notes.content:
[p][b]The G-Rebels Demo Returns for Gamescom – Play Until August 24![/b][/p][p align="start"]Thank you so much for your incredible feedback on the G-Rebels demo! 🙌
With [b]over 80% positive reviews[/b] and a [b]“Mostly Positive”[/b] rating on Steam, your support has been incredibly motivating – we truly appreciate it![/p][p align="start"]🎮 To celebrate [b]Gamescom 2025[/b], we’ve decided to [b]re-release the demo on Steam until August 24[/b]. If you missed it earlier – or just want to dive back in – now’s the perfect time![/p][p align="start"]🛠️ [b]No new features, but noticeable improvements[/b] While this demo doesn’t include new content, we’ve made [b]first optimizations based on your feedback[/b]. At the same time, we’re actively working on many other areas inspired by your input.[/p][p align="start"]📍 [b]Visit G-Rebels at Gamescom – Hall 10.2, Home of Indies[/b]
From [b]August 20 to 24[/b], you can experience G-Rebels live at [b]Gamescom in Cologne[/b].
Our [b]promo team[/b] will be on-site to guide you through the demo, answer questions, and collect feedback – while our dev team continues working hard behind the scenes.[/p][p align="start"]💬 [b]Join our community on Discord[/b]
We’d love to hear more from you! Join our [b]Discord Channel [/b]to chat with the community, ask questions, and stay up to date on development.[/p][p align="start"][/p]

notes.title: Your First Flight Begins – Play the G-Rebels Demo Now!
notes.content: [p]Get your first taste of [i]G-Rebels[/i]! In this demo, you'll learn to pilot your Skyblade through an interactive tutorial, take on early missions, and explore the vibrant capital city of Daevos – just one of many stunning locations in the full game. Meet key characters who will provide valuable intel and missions later on. Earn your first credits, upgrade your ship, and – with a bit of luck – qualify for a high-speed race through the streets of Daevos.[/p][p]Please note: this demo represents only a small slice of what [i]G-Rebels[/i] has to offer and is still undergoing technical optimization. We’d love to hear your feedback – join us on Discord and help shape the future of the game![/p][p]Get ready for your rebellion test flight![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/gtX92Re7Ek" style="button"]DISCORD[/url][/p]

notes.title: Upcoming cyberpunk flight sim G-Rebels is like a more intense Elite Dangerous
notes.content:
I'd like to think videogames make flying easy. Even in Microsoft Flight Simulator, if you customize the settings and tweak the difficulty, you can make an intercontinental journey in a 747 feel like a breeze. Freedom, exploration, spectacle - these are some of the things that games do best. If you take the mechanics of a plane simulator, blend them with the galactic narrative of Star Citizen, and throw in some of Cyberpunk 2077's hard-edged aesthetic, you get G-Rebels, a new flying and dogfight game that's just been announced.
